name: Homeway
short_desc: Free, secure remote access for Home Assistant
author: Homeway
description: Homeway provides free, secure remote access to your Home Assistant instance, plus Amazon Alexa and Google Assistant integration and free remote access notifications. It runs as a lightweight relay container alongside Home Assistant — no port forwarding, VPN or dynamic DNS required.

form_fields.label: Home Assistant IP / hostname
form_fields.hint: IP or hostname of your Home Assistant server.

form_fields.label: Long-Lived Access Token
form_fields.hint: Create one in Home Assistant under Profile > Security.
